matches.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

In a dynamic international trade environment, compliance is the key to sustainable success. As a Working Student (m/f/d) in Export Control/ International Trade Compliance, you will actively support our International Trade Compliance team in the operational implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of our global export control processes. You will apply your theoretical knowledge directly to complex cases involving German, European, and US export regulations (EAR/ITAR).
In this role, your work is the vanguard of our integrity. By rigorously enforcing export controls, managing licenses, and conducting thorough due diligence, you ensure that our advanced satellite technologies and sensitive data do not fall into the wrong hands. Your daily vigilance directly upholds Planet’s core values of global transparency, ethical business practices, and global security—allowing us to continue democratizing access to space while remaining a trusted, responsible partner on the global stage.

Because compliance touches every aspect of our global operations, this role acts as a central hub. On a day-to-day basis, you will collaborate closely with: Product Managers & Engineering, Sales & Go-to-Market Teams, Logistics & Supply Chain, Purchasing/ Procurement, Internal IT & Operations, Physical Security & Lab Management.

This is a temporary, part-time position and is expected to last 12 months. This hybrid position will require you to work from our Berlin office approx. 2 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Classification & Screening: Assist in determining and assigning export control classification numbers (ECCN, national list numbers) as well as conducting systemic sanction list screenings, with Product Manager. 
  • Licensing Processes: Conduct preliminary checks of licensing requirements (BAFA, EU regulations) and US re-export regulations (EAR / ITAR) and support with preparation of license applications and license management, as needed.
  • Documentation: Ensure transparent and audit-proof documentation of decision-making processes and audit trails.
  • Contract Review: Review and evaluate export control-relevant clauses in customer and supplier agreements.
  • Legal Monitoring: Monitor legal changes in national and international foreign trade law and prepare their implications for day-to-day business operations.
  • Processes & IT: Support process modeling, identify optimization potential, and coordinate interfaces with internal IT systems (e.g., ERP/NetSuite/Oracle).
  • Communication: Act as a central link and point of contact for internal departments such as Sales, Purchasing, Logistics, and IT.
  • AccessControls Lab/ Visitor Requests: Evaluate and approve visitor requests and laboratory access permissions to mitigate deemed export risks, ensuring compliance with physical security protocols and technology transfer controls in sensitive areas.
  • Review international Shipments: Perform export compliance reviews and release holds on international outbound shipments, verifying end-use, licensing coverage, and documentation prior to dispatch.
  • Anti-Bribery/KYC/DueDiligence: Conduct risk-based third-party due diligence and Know-Your-Customer (KYC) assessments on business partners, evaluating red flags and enforcing adherence to anti-bribery and anti-corruption (ABAC) policies.

What You Bring:

  • Actively enrolled in an accredited university program in Business Law (LL.B.), International Trade, Logistics/Supply Chain Management with a focus on Customs, or a comparable degree program.
  • Fluent written and spoken German and English (essential for navigating legal references).
  • Interest in foreign trade issues, ideally paired with initial exposure to EU Dual Use Regulation or US export control regulations like Export Administration Regulation (EAR)/ International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR).
  • Detail-oriented with solid analytical capabilities; equipped with the ability to pragmatically translate complex legal texts into actionable corporate workflows.
  • Proficiency in Google Office Application; familiarity with ERP systems or process modeling tools is an advantage.

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.

 Bling ist Deutschlands führende Familien-Finanz-App: Taschengeldkarte, Sparfunktionen und Finanzbildung für über 150.000 Familien. Du übernimmst die Themen mit der höchsten Priorität, übersetzt strategisches Potenzial in umsetzbare Projekte, schaffst Prozesse, die skalieren, und machst uns dort schneller, wo es den größten Unterschied macht.

 Bling Schule ist eine eigene Gesellschaft und digitalisiert den Schulalltag: Schulverpflegung, Schulkiosk, Klassenkasse und Abrechnung auf einer Plattform, über 100 Einrichtungen sind live. Der Markt ist von veralteter Software geprägt, rund ein Drittel aller Schulen arbeitet noch komplett analog. Ein Speedboat mit Startup-Charakter, nur mit dem Rückenwind eines Scale-ups.

 Bling for Banks ist unsere White-Label-Lösung für Familienbanking: Banken bekommen ihre eigene, gebrandete Familien-App, wir betreiben Technologie und Regulatorik im Hintergrund. Für sie ist das die Antwort auf ein bekanntes Problem ohne bisherige Lösung – den Verlust der nächsten Kundengeneration an Neobanken. In dieser Form gibt es das im deutschen Markt nicht. Unsere Pipeline ist stark, mehrere Banken sind bereits in der LOI-Phase, und wir bauen damit einen Präzedenzfall für einen ganzen Sektor. Wer hier zuerst liefert, definiert den Standard. Deshalb zählt jede Woche.

 Deine Aufgaben

 1. Strategische Projekte & Partnerschaften

 Du planst und setzt strategische Projekte gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung um und identifizierst die Themen mit dem größten Hebel und schaffst die Grundlage dafür, dass wir 2027 auf das Zehnfache skalieren können.

 Du findest, bewertest und qualifizierst Multiplikatoren und strategische Partner jeglicher Form, bereitest die Termine vor und begleitest sie bis zum Abschluss inklusive Unterstützung bei Verhandlungen, Erstellung von Entscheidungsvorlagen & Onboarding.

 Du baust Prozesse, Sequenzen und CRM-Strukturen auf, die systematisch qualifizierte Leads erzeugen und steuerst Outbound-Kampagnen mit.

 Du analysierst KPIs entlang des Sales-Funnels und leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab

 3. AI Operations & GTM-Engineering 

 Wir sind bewusst AI-first. Du baust eigene Workflows mit Tools wie Claude und n8n, um Recherche, Outreach, Analyse und Reporting zu skalieren

 Du automatisierst unsere Kern- und Betriebsprozesse, wo der Hebel am größten ist und du erledigst damit Themen, für die früher ganze Teams nötig waren

 4. Special Projects

 Du übernimmst bereichsübergreifende Projekte mit Sales, Operations, Product, Finance und Legal

 Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung und Gründerteam an C-Level-Themen für Investoren, Joint Ventures und strategischen Partnern

 Du agierst als unternehmerischer Allrounder mit hoher Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit und Hands-on-Mentalität und treibst Themen an, die keinem Team fest zugeordnet sind, aber gemacht werden müssen

 Dein Profil

 Wie du denkst und was du aufgebaut hast, zählt mehr als wo du warst.

 Ownership. Du erkennst, was zu tun ist, und fängst an, ohne auf Anweisungen zu warten.

 Company Building. Du willst aus erster Hand erleben, wie ein Unternehmen von null aufgebaut wird, so effizient und AI-native wie heute möglich.

 Der Rahmen: Du hast erste Praxiserfahrung durch Praktika oder Jobs in schnelllebigen Umfeldern, ein laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Studium (jeder Background willkommen). Fließendes Deutsch (C2) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch sind ein Muss. Wir arbeiten hybrid mit Office-First Fokus, da diese Rolle von enger Zusammenarbeit lebt.

Notre mission ⚖️ 

 Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

 Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

 Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

 Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

 Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

 Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

 Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

 Contexte du stage

Depuis des années, Doctrine propose une fonctionnalité d’envoi de décision de justice en France à ses clients. Cela est une source précieuse de décisions de justice qui permet à Doctrine d’enrichir sa base de données (c'est-à-dire son legal graph) avec des décisions qui n’ont pas pu être ajoutées par nos processus habituels.

Le but de ce stage est l’internationalisation de cette fonctionnalité de manière à ce qu’elle soit utilisable dans tous les autres pays où Doctrine est actif (Italie, Allemagne).

Les tâches principales seront :

 Le développement d’une application minimale pour la revue et validation des décisions de justice mises en ligne par nos utilisateurs pour nos juristes avant leur publication.

 La migration du processus legacy d’upload français actuel pour se conformer au processus commun (internationalisé).

 Une fois que le processus de mise en ligne de décisions par nos utilisateurs sera internationalisé, le ou la stagiaire pourra travailler sur des tâches d’amélioration de l’application de revue de décisions dans le but d’aider notre équipe de juristes à mieux traiter le volume de décisions mises en ligne.

Exemples de pistes d’amélioration (non exhaustif)

 Application de techniques d’OCR sur les documents pour faciliter leur validation.

 Détection via LLM d’attributs des décisions (niveau de confidentialité, juridiction, domaine du droit, cour, …) pour faciliter leur validation.

 Aide au retrait de contenu qui n’est pas le texte de la décision (pages blanches, notification à l’avocat, …).
Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la définition de la solution et sa réalisation. Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Italie et sera amené·e à travailler avec les équipes des autres pays (principalement l’équipe France) et l’équipe légale. Il ou elle participera aussi au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs full stack de l’entreprise).

 Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :

 Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)

 Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)

 Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

 Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝 

 Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.

 Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.

 Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.

 Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

 Nos valeurs 🤝 

 Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

 Challenge the status quo : n ous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.

 Liberty and responsibility : n ous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.

 Knowledge is power : l 'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.

 Release early, release often and listen to your customers : n ous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

 Quote

 Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Looking to start full-time in 2027? Our Graduate Quantitative Researcher (2027 Start) role is currently open. Apply here.

If you enjoy using mathematics and code to investigate difficult questions, you could make a direct contribution to Optiver’s success in global markets. As a Graduate Quantitative Researcher, you’ll work across the full research process, from framing the question and choosing the data to building, testing and deploying models. Machine Learning is central to the work, whether you’re extracting signals, forecasting prices or modelling relationships. Our data, compute and production infrastructure let you test ideas quickly, understand where they fail and decide what to investigate next.

Our researchers believe in academic discourse and invite fellow researchers, traders and engineers to challenge each hypothesis. Different perspectives help improve the question, the model and how it performs in production. Through constant testing, analysis and refinement, you’ll help our quantitative models adapt as markets evolve.

Your onboarding

It gives new joiners a shared foundation in how Optiver trades, builds systems, and manages risk before they move into their teams. As part of your onboarding, you'll gain exposure to the AI tools and technologies that support research and development across the business.

Depending on the team you join, you'll own the research end to end. That could include:

  • Building models for pricing, forecasting and signal discovery, choosing the statistical, mathematical or Machine Learning methods that best fit the problem.
  • Working across petabytes of market, order-flow and unstructured data to find signals that improve strategies as conditions change.
  • Monitoring models in production and using live behavior to refine your assumptions and decide what to investigate next.
  • Using deep learning and AI-enabled workflows to shorten the loop from hypothesis to evidence.
  • Working directly with researchers, traders and engineers to shape problems and understand how system constraints affect performance.

We're looking for aspiring Quantitative Researchers who are versatile and creative in innovating and suggesting new solutions. In return, we'll give you the freedom to pursue your ideas and implement them right into our production systems. 

In terms of skills and qualifications, we're looking for:

 The opportunity
 Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.
 We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.
 About us
 planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.
 What you'll own
 The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.

 Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.

 Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.

 Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.

 Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.

 The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.

 How we build
 Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations.
 We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.
 We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.

 Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

 ***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role. 
 A day in the life:
 You'll sit on the Data Team, which owns the core data foundation for Power Digital: the pipelines, modeling, and data marts that power our agency teams, clients, and AI initiatives. You'll work end to end, from raw ingestion through the semantic layer, using AI-agentic workflows as a normal part of how you build.
 The data itself is the interesting part. Marketing data is fragmented by default. Every ad platform has its own API, its own schema, and its own definition of a conversion. Platforms restate attributed conversions days after the fact, each in a different way. Entity hierarchies don't match (campaign/ad set/ad on Meta, campaign/ad group/ad on Google). Naming conventions, currencies, and timezones vary by client.
 We do this across a large client portfolio, each client with a different stack, in a warehouse with per-client tenancy. You'll work closely with Client Service, BI, Tagging & Tracking, Data Ops, and the nova product/engineering teams.
 Key Responsibilities:

 Design, build, and maintain the core data foundation (ingestion, modeling, and data marts), owning the workflow from raw platform data through the serving layers that support agency, client, internal, and AI consumers.

 Build ingestion that handles what ad platforms actually do: API changes, deprecated fields, aggressive rate limits, and retroactive restatement of conversion data, all without corrupting downstream models.

 Model across sources so the numbers reconcile: spend, impressions, conversions, and revenue across Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon, LinkedIn, and Microsoft, plus customer-level joins across Shopify, Klaviyo, GA4, and client CRMs.

 Contribute to client-bespoke modeling on top of the core layer: custom logic, overrides, and client-specific marts built in response to individual client requests, with patterns that extend the shared foundation rather than fork it. This is steady, recurring work, not an occasional exception.

 Build the semantic layers and metric definitions that let AI-generated SQL return consistent, correct answers.

 Use AI-agentic workflows, including AI coding tools, to accelerate development and build intelligent data infrastructure. Document what works so it becomes a standard team pattern.

 Collaborate cross-functionally with nova (product and engineering), AI/innovation, and client teams to translate requirements into data solutions and support rapid iteration on new products and features.

 Monitor and resolve data quality issues, and optimize pipelines for cost and performance across a multi-client warehouse.

 Role Requirements: 

 3+ years in data or analytics engineering, including 1+ years owning a dbt project of meaningful size in production, not just contributing models to one.

 Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with a focus on production-grade code for data pipelines and modeling.

 Deep expertise in dbt, not just writing models. Incremental strategies and full-refresh tradeoffs, Jinja and macros, packages, generic and singular tests, snapshots, source freshness, exposures, and how to keep a large project's DAG and materializations under control.

 Strong command of Snowflake and the surrounding cloud data stack to operate autonomously as a foundational data owner.
